teacher

This person teaching Joanna Yonge is probably to be identified as Agnes Baker (b.1863/4), daughter of the Rev.

James Baker of Clifton Lodge, Winchester, who is described, like her sister Emily (b. 1858/9) in the 1891 census as a Teacher of Music.
